credits.title: Aguacero
credits.overview: Aguacero is a dystopian drama set in 2019, after torrential rains devastated the country and plunged it into crisis. The story follows Carlos Muñoz and his daughter Valeria, who face a crucial decision: to leave or to stay. While their safety is threatened outside, old family conflicts and regrets resurface at home.

credits.title: Hambre
credits.overview: In crisis-stricken Venezuela, two former schoolmates run into each other years after graduating and face a question that puts their identity to test. Will they rebuild their homeland or be forced to migrate?

credits.title: Qué buena broma, Bromelia
credits.overview: Bromelia dreams of a love for the rest of her life, while sewing trousseaus in her mother's bridal shop. When Pedro finally arrives, the love he yearns for so much will bring forth captivating and unexpected experiences.
